title: Bee Removal in St. George, Staten Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in St. George, Staten Island. Nest treatment and removal near Staten Island Ferry Terminal.
intro: St. George, Staten Island's bustling waterfront neighborhood, faces steady pressure from wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees nesting in historic buildings, modern condos, and structures near the harbor. Our licensed technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat and remove wasp and hornet nests from wall voids, eaves, and attics, seal entry points to prevent recolonization, and treat carpenter bee galleries in structural wood. Same-day service available throughout St. George — call (855) 930-5016.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over 15 years of experience serving St. George and all of Staten Island with licensed, insured technicians who understand the specific needs of this waterfront community. We offer transparent pricing, eco-friendly removal methods, and guaranteed results for all residential and commercial properties in the St. George area.
localContext: From the historic buildings near Borough Hall to the residential streets surrounding St. George Theatre and the waterfront parks along Richmond Terrace, wasps and hornets establish paper nests in eaves, wall cavities, soffits, and hidden voids behind siding. Yellow jackets nest in the ground and inside wall voids. Carpenter bees bore galleries into wooden trim, fascia, and porch posts on century-old brownstones and modern condominiums near the Staten Island Ferry Terminal. Our team is familiar with St. George's diverse architecture and the access challenges that come with waterfront humidity and older masonry, ensuring safe nest treatment and structural sealing tailored to your property type.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in St. George, Staten Island?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — a ground yellow jacket nest is simpler than a hornet colony inside a second-story wall void. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in St. George?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in St. George?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day service throughout St. George and Staten Island. Most wasp and hornet nest treatments — including nest removal and entry-point sealing — are completed in 2–4 hours. Larger colonies inside wall voids or attics may require additional access work. We'll provide a clear timeline during your free phone quote.

faqs.question: What areas of St. George do you service for stinging insect removal?
faqs.answer: We service all of St. George, including areas near the Staten Island Ferry Terminal, St. George Theatre, Richmond County Courthouse, Staten Island Yankees stadium, and all surrounding residential neighborhoods. Our technicians are familiar with the entire St. George community and can reach any location quickly for wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal.
